name: SOC 2 Type II Trust Services Criteria (Security)

controls.title: Logical Access Controls & Least Privilege
controls.description: The entity restricts logical access to registered, authorized identities and workloads.
controls.mappingRationale: Verifies IAM role boundaries, service account trust policies, and hardcoded credential exposure.

controls.title: Boundary Protection & Network Segmentation
controls.description: Logical boundaries are implemented to protect internal networks and sensitive assets from external ingress.
controls.mappingRationale: Verifies that ingress load balancers and APIs enforce segmentation and do not expose unauthenticated paths to internal databases or compute.

controls.title: Transmission Data Protection & In-Transit Encryption
controls.description: The entity restricts the transmission, movement, and transfer of data across communication boundaries.
controls.mappingRationale: Detects unencrypted HTTP, plaintext database communication, or cleartext RPC traffic.

controls.title: Vulnerability Management & Malicious Software Prevention
controls.description: The entity detects, assesses, and remediates vulnerabilities in workloads and applications.
controls.mappingRationale: Identifies CVE advisories in third-party libraries and code execution / SQL injection injection flaws.

controls.title: Vulnerability Detection & Security Event Monitoring
controls.description: The entity uses vulnerability detection infrastructure to monitor system components for exposures.
controls.mappingRationale: Analyzes Kubernetes pods, securityContext configurations, and root privilege escalation vectors.

controls.title: Physical Perimeter Security
controls.description: Physical access to facilities housing IT infrastructure and data center assets is restricted.
controls.mappingRationale: NOT OBSERVABLE: Physical security badges, security guards, and biometrics cannot be evaluated from code or cloud topology.

controls.title: HR Background Checks & Employee Onboarding
controls.description: Background checks and screening are conducted for personnel prior to employment.
controls.mappingRationale: NOT OBSERVABLE: HR recruitment, hiring verification, and background checks are out of scope for architectural security scanners.

controls.title: Vendor & Third-Party Risk Management
controls.description: The entity assesses and manages risks associated with vendors and business partners.
controls.mappingRationale: NOT OBSERVABLE: Vendor contracts, SLAs, and third-party audit reports require administrative procurement review.
